sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 645 x 465 x 98 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dealer pages (Thomann, Go Knight, Reverb) read by a research pass 2026-11-12: 16 XLR mic inputs, 16 mono line inputs, 4 stereo inputs, XLR master outputs, 4 aux sends, per-channel inserts, a footswitch jack, 1/4 in headphone, record and alt outputs, one USB-B (2 in, 2 out); counts of the master outputs, inserts and headphone jacks are not stated and the mains connection is not stated. Ports are the Bêta proposal ports (a subset of 7 of 39 listed); beta-modelled. The sloped profile is an estimate (same as the ZED-14). 645 x 465 x 98 mm (dealer, size ok; weight 10.5 or 11.5 kg and height 95 or 98 mm differ between pages). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
